decisions.reason: Enabling a Discord welcome bot does not change the approved About-page content or any of its current copy attributes.
The Mission page uses community language descriptively, but the welcome-bot decision does not require any change to its content.
The welcome-bot decision does not change the Project Rebuild or BooksOnChain naming rules.
Discord welcome automation is unrelated to the landing-page hero copy, emphasis, and layout.
Adding a Discord welcome bot does not alter the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
The Discord welcome-bot decision has no effect on mobile-wallet signing or ebook access.
Discord server automation does not change NFT ownership gating, Lit Protocol, or ebook decryption behavior.
The source concerns Discord welcome automation, not prize payment, winner announcements, or claim behavior.
A Discord welcome bot is distinct from on-chain achievement badge triggers and award rules.
The client accepts welcome-bot setup but does not direct any FAQ or published support-channel copy change; any Discord-server availability update would belong to its own earlier source decision.
The Discord welcome-bot decision does not affect certificate-email availability, contents, or read links.
Discord welcome automation does not change referral qualification, commission amount, recipient, or delivery behavior.
